sql: select distinct on (s.market_ticker) s.market_ticker, s.at, s.best_yes_bid, s.best_no_bid, s.yes_depth_total, s.no_depth_total, s.est_yes_meets_target y_ok, s.est_no_meets_target n_ok, s.yes_levels_json, p.target_size, p.discount_factor_bps from incentive_market_snapshots s left join lateral (select target_size, discount_factor_bps from incentive_programs p where p.market_ticker=s.market_ticker order by last_seen_at desc limit 1) p on true where s.market_ticker in ('KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-MADE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT20-FEMA','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT20-NUCL','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT20-VETE','KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-CATT','KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT19-NQE') order by s.market_ticker, s.at desc
